input.how: Focus and press a key combination. Backspace clears, Escape cancels.
input.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt or Shift (or use an F-key).

validation.lockRequired: Required: it is the only way to unlock a click-through meter.
validation.activePresetMissing: The active preset no longer exists.
validation.presetNameTaken: Another preset already uses this name.
validation.tooManyBars: A preset can hold up to 32 bars.
validation.skillIds: Skill ids must be positive whole numbers.
validation.barX: X must be a whole number in −20000..20000.

validation.dateTime: Pick a valid date and time.
validation.firstTime: An enabled alert needs a first time.

unavailable.title: Settings unavailable
unavailable.body: Waiting for the native engine to report its settings.
unavailable.bodyBrowser: Run Aion Companion to edit local settings.

meter.title: Meter & fights
meter.description: How damage is ranked and when a fight ends.
meter.dpsShownHint: Encounter divides by the fight length; active divides by each player’s time in combat.
meter.idleTimeout: End fight after no damage for
meter.idleTimeoutHint: Bosses stay open until killed or reset.
meter.refreshHint: 50–1000 ms. Lower is smoother but uses more CPU.

dummy.title: Training dummy
dummy.description: Fixed-length runs against dummies; the fight ends automatically at the limit.
dummy.lengthHint: 0 turns the timer off; otherwise 10–300 s.
dummy.cooldownHint: Hits during the pause do not start a new run.

appearance.title: Overlay appearance
appearance.description: Applied by the DPS meter window right away after saving.
appearance.compactStripHintKey: A single-line meter. {{shortcut}} toggles it in game.

privacy.title: Privacy & clipboard
privacy.description: Everything stays on this PC. Summaries go only to your clipboard.
privacy.hideNamesHint: Shows class and rank instead, in the meter and workspace. Copied summaries still use names.

hotkeysSection.title: Hotkeys
hotkeysSection.description: Global shortcuts, active while the game is focused.

library.title: Local library
library.sizeUnknown: Library size unknown. Logs never leave this PC.
library.size_one: {{count, number}} saved log. Logs never leave this PC.
library.size_other: {{count, number}} saved logs. Logs never leave this PC.
library.actionsHint: Clear finishes the current fight (saving it if auto-save is on) and empties the live meter.

catalogue.title: Skill & NPC catalogue
catalogue.importHint: <0/>. Cooldowns are only used when given explicitly in milliseconds.

region.title: Region & language
region.twkrHint: TW/KR packet layouts are shared with Global but not yet validated on live servers.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Applies to every window after you save.
language.unsupportedHint: The saved language is not translated, so English is shown. It is kept until you pick another language and save.
